data.heading: Data we store
data.body: StudyWork Planner stores your name, email, and an encrypted password (argon2id) for the account, plus the tasks, categories, moods, and notification subscriptions you create.

purpose.heading: Why we process it
purpose.body: Your data is used only to compute task priorities, show your personal statistics, recommend tasks based on your mood, and send reminders you have enabled.

storage.heading: Storage & security
storage.body: Data is kept on the project server and protected by an HttpOnly session cookie. The browser only stores your language preference, task form draft, and app-install hint.

sharing.heading: Data sharing
sharing.body: None of your data is shared with third parties or used for advertising. Recommendations are computed on our server without sending data to external AI services.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can edit or delete your tasks and categories at any time, turn notifications off in Settings, and ask the system administrator to remove your account.
